probe.title: Your Page Title
probe.text_sample: Your Page Title Overview Buy Hemingway Magazine Fashion Design Music Culture Travel Podcast Latest: Making records slowly About Authors Membership Contact Sign in The tailor who refuses to hurry A magazine about people who make things slowly Quaderno started in 2019 as a letter between three friends in Seville. It is now a magazine and a podcast about fashion, design, music, culture and travel, still written and edited around one table. How we work Four rules since the first letter (01) We go there. Every profile is reported in person. If we write about a workshop, someone from Quaderno has stood in it. (02) Everyone edits everyone. No piece goes out with one name on it alone. Each essay passes through the other two writers before the editor sees it. (03) Nothing is sponsored. We take no ads and no gifted products. Members pay for the magazine, so the magazine answers to them. (04) Fewer, longer. Two essays a month and one conversation. We would rather publish less than publish in a hurry.
